environment.description: Same provider binary deployed behind an Envoy sidecar proxy (Istio service mesh) with PeerAuthentication policy set to STRICT mode on the namespace. The ingress is handled by an Istio IngressGateway with a Gateway resource specifying credentialName referencing a Kubernetes secret containing a CA bundle (internal-ca-bundle) for client certificate validation. The DestinationRule for the service enforces ISTIO_MUTUAL TLS mode. Additionally, an AuthorizationPolicy resource scoped to the workload requires the source principal to match 'cluster.local/ns/terraform-controllers/sa/tf-plan-executor'. The container itself still runs the same binary on port 8443 but Envoy intercepts all inbound traffic on port 15006. The pod has an annotation 'traffic.sidecar.istio.io/includeInboundPorts: 8443' ensuring no bypass via direct pod IP. Network attachment only permits traffic from the mesh data plane.
